description: This script converts a PyTorch checkpoint of a GPT-NeoX model into a HuggingFace Transformers format, including loading model weights, configuration, and tokenizer, and saving the converted model.
external_files: hf_save_dir (directory to save the converted model)

classes.name: GPTNeoXConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for GPT-NeoX model from HuggingFace transformers

classes.name: GPTNeoXForCausalLM
classes.description: GPT-NeoX causal language model class from HuggingFace transformers

classes.name: GPT2Tokenizer
classes.description: Tokenizer class from HuggingFace transformers for GPT-2 models

methods.name: get_hf_state_dict_from_pt_files
methods.description: Loads and converts model weights from .pt files into a state dict compatible with HuggingFace model
